requirements.title: Scalar storage, total, and partial association are storage-sequence relations
requirements.source: S19.5.3.4 p1, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF560.
requirements.definition: Scalar data objects are storage associated exactly through associated storage sequences; scalar entities are totally associated through the same storage sequence and partially associated through association without total association.

pending.scalar-storage-associated-through-sequen: EQUIVALENCE two default integer scalars, seed one name to -777, assign the other to 616, and assert the seeded name reads 616.
pending.total-association-same-sequence: Use two equivalenced default integer scalars of the same type and size, assign first 12 then second 34, and assert each name observes the latest exact value.
pending.partial-association-not-total: EQUIVALENCE character(len=4) whole with character(len=2) part at the first character, seed whole="WXYZ", assign part="ab", and assert whole=="abYZ".

requirements.title: Storage-associated definition status and values propagate through associated entities
requirements.source: S19.5.3.4 p2.status-value-effects, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF560.
requirements.definition: The definition status and value of a data object affect any storage-associated entity.

requirements.title: EQUIVALENCE, COMMON, and ENTRY can cause storage association
requirements.definition: EQUIVALENCE causes local storage association except through common-block participation; COMMON causes inter-scoping-unit storage association; ENTRY in a function subprogram causes storage association of variable function results.

pending.equivalence-local-or-common-storage-asso: Use one local EQUIVALENCE pair and one COMMON member equivalenced to a local object; seed all numeric storage units to distinct sentinels, assign through the alternate names, and assert exact propagated values.
pending.common-interscope-storage-association: Writer and reader procedures declare matching named COMMON /packet/ with two default integers; writer assigns [123,-456], reader starts result sentinels at [-777,-778], and reader returns [123,-456].
pending.entry-function-result-storage-associatio: Source-control plan for a function with ENTRY returning the same result storage: assign through one variable result path and assert the alternate entry result observes the same default integer value under a conforming ENTRY fixture.

requirements.title: Common-block storage-unit sequences have named and blank-block rules
requirements.definition: A common block may contain differing storage-unit kinds; same-named common blocks in all accessing scopes have identical storage-unit sequences; blank common blocks may differ in size but any shared prefix must have identical storage-unit sequences.

pending.common-block-mixed-storage-units-permitt: Declare COMMON /mix/ i,ch with default integer and default character length two, assign i=45 and ch="QR", and assert a matching scope observes both exact values without assuming a byte layout.
pending.named-common-identical-sequence-required: Source-control pair uses two scopes with COMMON /same/ default integer then default real; negative mutation reverses the sequence in only one scope, and the positive control changes only that order back.
pending.blank-common-size-may-differ: Use blank COMMON with a one-integer prefix in a reader and a two-integer block in a writer; writer assigns [17,29], reader observes only the first exact value 17.
pending.blank-common-prefix-identical-required: Source-control pair gives two blank common blocks of unequal length with the same default-integer prefix; negative mutation changes only the prefix type in the shorter scope while retaining the size relation.

requirements.title: Partial association is restricted by object categories and association mechanisms
requirements.source: S19.5.3.4 p7,p8,p9, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF560.
requirements.definition: Partial association is permitted only for the listed character and numeric categories; noncharacter partial association occurs only through COMMON, EQUIVALENCE, or ENTRY, character partial association only through argument association, COMMON, or EQUIVALENCE, and character partial association means some but not all character storage units are shared.

pending.partial-association-character-or-numeric: Source-control program uses valid default character partial association and valid default complex/default real partial association; negative mutations replace one participant with an ineligible derived type without changing the mechanism.
pending.noncharacter-partial-association-mechani: Use EQUIVALENCE between default complex and default real to expose one real part, seed complex to (9.0,10.0), and assert the real view observes 9.0 exactly for the first part.
pending.character-partial-association-mechanisms: Use argument association with a character substring actual and a full dummy, seed the actual string to "wxyz", assign dummy="AB", and assert the actual becomes "AByz".
pending.character-partial-association-some-units: EQUIVALENCE character(len=4) whole with character(len=2) prefix, seed whole="lmno", assign prefix="PQ", and assert whole=="PQno" while len(prefix)<len(whole).

requirements.title: Storage-unit initialization has single-explicit and precedence rules
requirements.definition: A storage unit is not explicitly initialized more than once; explicit initialization overrides default initialization; object default initialization overrides component default initialization; default initialization of storage-associated units is permitted only with same type, type parameters, and value.

pending.storage-unit-explicit-initialization-onc: Source-control program explicitly initializes one DATA-associated storage unit once; negative mutation adds a second DATA initialization of the equivalenced name and changes no other feature.
pending.explicit-overrides-default-initializatio: Define type t with component default x=3, declare saved object with explicit initializer t(88), copy obj%x to sentinel -777 at first execution, and assert 88.
pending.object-default-overrides-component-defau: Define inner type with component default x=3 and outer type with component default inner(7); declare saved outer object, copy obj%component%x to sentinel -777, and assert 7.
pending.compatible-default-initialization-permit: Use two storage-associated default-initialized default integer objects supplying the same value 5 and assert startup reads 5; negative source mutation changes only one initializer to 6.

Definition/value effects and causing constructs are split.
Names constructs that can cause storage association.

Common-block permission and restrictions are split.
Mixed storage-unit common blocks are permitted.
Initialization prohibition, precedence and permission are split.
